title: Iplutt's World
description: A simple mod that adds a few biomes to the dimensions (currently only the end).
body:
**Iplutt's World is a mod that adds many new variants of old blocks and a few new ones. It also adds some new biomes to the end. In the future I will add more biomes to the Nether and the Overworld.**

![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50a357b47072bc4764eec350077b75cdedf6ec37_0.webp)
### Made using MCreator:
This mod was made using MCreator. It would be impossible for me to make this without it. 
I made every texture myself (sometimes I just edit vanilla textures).


<details>
<summary>Features (Spoilers)</summary>

- End Plains Biome
- End Mire Biome (Very Early Version)
- 55+ Blocks
- 1 Sword (No recipe)
- More comming soon...

</details>


<details>
<summary>Plans</summary>

- 6 new biomes to The Nether and The End.
- 100+ new blocks
- New Items, Weapons, and Foods.
- 6 new mobs.



</details>



Hope you enjoy...
